autoexec.scriptcontenttips:
Help:
Tool execution uses standard command line parameters to pass parameters. 
Input parameters:
1) Parameters with parameter names:
option name is the parameter name, option value is the parameter value. 
2) Parameters without parameter names: 
Corresponds to the free parameters of the tool, and obtains the parameters through the parameter serial number. 
How different programming languages ​​handle command line parameters, please check the relevant demos for details. 
Output parameters:
The parameters are output by writing the output parameters to the json file ouput.json in the current job working directory. 
The platform provides output packages in different languages. For details, please view the relevant demos, for example:
Python:
fromlibimportAutoExecUtils
out={}
out['outtext']='thisisthetextoutvalue'
AutoExecUtils.saveOutput(out)
Perl :
useAutoExecUtils;
my$out={};
$out->{outtext}='thisisthetextoutvalue';
AutoExecUtils::saveOutput($out);
Bash:
outtext='thisisthetextoutvalue'
if[!- z'$OUTPUT_PATH'];then
cat<<EOF>'$OUTPUT_PATH'
{
'outtext':'$outtext'
}
EOF
fi
Exit code identification:
As long as ExitCode is not equal to 0 represents an abnormal exit. 
Note:
If you need to initiate a child process, please be sure to close the standard output and error output after execution, otherwise the parent process may not exit normally.
